items.title: Relative perfect complexes on a directed limit of spaces descend to a finite stage
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: In the chapter's relative descent situation (X = X_0 x_{S_0} S over a directed limit S of schemes with X_0 -> S_0 quasi-compact quasi-separated and Y_0 -> X_0 a morphism with Y = Y_0 x_{S_0} S), the category of Y-perfect objects of D(O_X) is the colimit of the categories of Y_i-perfect objects of D(O_{X_i}). The retained proof sets up the condition P on qcqs etale objects U_0 that the colimit of relative perfect derived categories map to the perfect derived category on the limit, notes full faithfulness is already established by the chapter's lemma-relative-descend-homomorphisms, reduces essential surjectivity to elementary distinguished squares, and closes by the induction principle for derived categories of spaces (Derived Categories of Spaces, lemma-induction-principle) to the case where X_0 and Y_0 are both affine, where the result is the schemes case (Derived Categories of Schemes, lemma-descend-relatively-perfect) transported through the chapter's lemma-affine-locally-rel-perfect. Retained author proof at lines 12505-12575.
